scope_note: Verification contract for the triage authority (authored 2026-10-11 in response to the adoption test: da verify previously aborted because the pack shipped no contract; authored per the references/verification.md discipline and calibrated against clean triage builds before shipping). Each check names the authority item it verifies, its classification, a mode and minimal deterministic assertions. REVIEW entries surface as REVIEW_REQUIRED and are never faked into PASS. Selector-based checks report UNVERIFIABLE (never PASS) when a selector is absent and missing is not fail, so partial surfaces cannot fake coverage. Calibration targets: the recipe-box consumer build (x06-adoption run1) plus the shipped list, dashboard and viewer examples.

checks.title: Primary fill is a token pairing (ink on paper; paper on the ink bulkbar)
checks.note: Standard contexts fill with the ink token; the ink bulkbar deliberately flips to the paper fill (.bulkbar .btn.primary). Any other fill is off-canon; the pairing is the contract.

checks.title: The body runs the system text face (Geist)
Badge labels meet the comfortable tier (13px, uppercase)
Identifiers and timestamps run the mono register
Status chips are single nowrap units
Every keyboard-focused control keeps a visible ring
The empty state ships its one action (icon + title + CTA anatomy)
A provenance record renders its required label-value fields
Destructive actions are armed inline (data-arm-label), never dialogs
checks.assertion: Where a delete/remove exists: it is the inline two-step armed control (data-arm-label) that announces afterwards, not a confirm() dialog; verify by inspection on surfaces the mechanical pass cannot reach.

checks.title: Copy names the object; sentence case; past-tense confirmations
checks.assertion: Destructive labels and confirmations name the object ('Deleted "Lemon pasta".'), sentence case for buttons/links/menus, no exclamation marks or emoji.

checks.title: Motion uses token durations; nothing decorative above one event
checks.assertion: Transitions consume --dur-* tokens, honour prefers-reduced-motion, and no animation runs beyond a single acknowledgement event (bursts degrade or stop under reduced motion).

checks.title: Conformance claims cite rule id, component, location and evidence
checks.assertion: Any conformance claim in the build's notes cites the four-part tuple; a global score is never quoted as proof that a specific requirement holds.
